description: This file defines the RuntimeConfig class for managing Spark session configurations, including methods to set, get, unset, and retrieve all configurations, as well as type checking and testing functions.

classes.name: RuntimeConfig
classes.description: User-facing configuration API for SparkSession, allowing setting, getting, unsetting, and retrieving all configuration properties.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes RuntimeConfig with a JVM configuration object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a Spark runtime configuration property.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a Spark runtime configuration property, with optional default.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all configuration properties as a dictionary.

methods.name: _check_type
methods.description: Checks that an object is of type str.

methods.name: isModifiable
methods.description: Checks if a configuration property is modifiable in the current session.
